name: delivered context
wording: a bounded context cratylus ships as part of the product: the current design of one of its own contexts, projected from its journal at release and placed read-only under the owned root, carrying its origin, its version and the identity of the context it was projected from; every project's views show it beside the project's own contexts under a name qualified by its origin, and never write it into the project's journal, while a project whose journal already holds that same context, by identity, reads its own instead.
